dataClassNote.reanalysis: A reanalysis blends observations with a physical model on a regular grid: not a direct measurement of the place.
dataClassNote.extrapolated: Carries the measured data beyond their period with a trend or a model: not a forecast.
dataClassNote.approximated: Estimated by distributing or combining other sources, with the error they carry.
dataClassNote.illustrative: A figure computed for an assumption with published coefficients; not a measurement of the place.

E0.name: Described
E0.note: The question and the plan are described; nothing has been measured.

E1.name: Trend
E1.note: A change over time, without a comparison area.

E1control.name: Compared, not attributable
E1control.note: A comparison area was used, but the zone and the control already differed before the milestone, so the difference cannot be attributed to it.

E2.name: Coincidence in time and place
E2.note: The change coincides in time and place with the works; that is not a cause.

E3.name: Association against a control
E3.note: The change stands out against a comparable area.

E4.name: Exceptional against placebos
E4.note: The association holds against placebo dates and places.

E5.name: Coherent chain
E5.note: Several independent lines agree; causality still needs the team's agreement.

home.headline: Any place on Earth.
home.lead: Ask Delfos what is changing where you care about: the climate, the land people transform, the water we depend on. Delfos decides what to look at and answers with its evidence and its limits.
home.globeAlt: Night globe with twelve places in three themes; the selected place shows its air temperature since 1981.
home.globeNote: The globe is an illustration with twelve reference places; your answer is computed for the place you ask about.
home.askPlaceholder: Ask about any place on Earth
home.starting: Delfos is calling on its informants…
home.leftRun: You stopped waiting; the analysis is still being computed and will appear in the Library.
home.cancelledRun: You cancelled the analysis. Your question is still here if you want to change it and ask again.
home.otherLabel: Type the place or give more context
home.otherHint: For example: Persian Gulf, Kuwait, the Ras Tanura refinery.
home.otherNotFound: «{text}» is not a place I can find; Delfos takes it as context for your question.
home.otherFailed: The place could not be looked up.
home.notPossible: Delfos cannot answer this with its informants.
home.check: Delfos decides what to look at; you can see how it decided while it answers.
home.fine: NASA POWER (MERRA-2), annual means 1981–2024. Trend: Mann-Kendall with an autocorrelation correction and Sen slope, Benjamini-Hochberg over 36 tests.

article.missing: This article is no longer available.
article.can: Delfos answers with data about a concrete place and period: how temperature, rain, vegetation or built-up surface have changed there; how many people live in an area that floods; or how much water and energy a new facility would need, with its range. Every answer says which sources hold it up and what it cannot say.
